newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Empresas ICA started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Empresas ICA started as buy.

text.p: -- Ing Barings said it has started coverage of Mexican construction company Empresas ICA with a buy recommendation.

-- "1997 is expected to be a good year for infrastructure investment; since it satisfies two government objectives: to improve Mexico's economy and to increase the ruling party's 1997 election chances," said Barings analyst Hector Castillo.
-- "Restructuring of existing concessions should inject cash, or reduce debt, in construction companies," he wrote.
-- ICA should benefit from a higher backlog and improved liquidity, the company said.
-- "Our 12-18 month price target for ICA is $19.80/ADR, based on a 1997 EPADR estimate of $0.99 and a 1997 P/E of 20.0," he wrote.
